title: Granted Limit on a Permanent Increase — Commercial Credit Account
content:
**Credit Department decision standard — the limit granted on a permanent increase of a Commercial Credit Account.**

### The request decided

The request decided is the permanent limit request with the latest request date on the account; when that request already carries a decision line, or when more than one permanent request carries that latest request date, nothing is decided under this rule and no limit is granted. The requested limit is the limit that request names.

### Grant

1. A permanent increase is approved when the account's trailing twelve-month on-time payment percentage is at least the tier's minimum for limit increases, and the granted limit is the requested limit capped at the step room and at the tier's credit limit ceiling, decided as approved when nothing is capped and as approved at a reduced limit when a cap applies; the step room replaces the tier's flat step percentage for every permanent request.
2. The step room is the current credit limit increased by the step percentage used, rounded to the nearest cent, and the step percentage used is the tier's largest permanent step percentage.
3. Every percentage point a schedule in this rule adds to or takes from the step percentage used is applied to it before the current credit limit is increased, and every amount a schedule adds is added to the step room once it is rounded.
4. When the increase granted, the granted limit less the current credit limit, exceeds the tier's desk approval amount, the request is decided referred to committee, the granted figure is nothing and the limit is unchanged.

The granted limit is the lowest of the requested limit, the step room and the tier's credit limit ceiling.

### Worked figures (hypothetical: tier step 50 percent, ceiling 149999.00, desk approval 25000.00)

| Current limit | Requested | Step room | Granted | Increase | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 40000.00 | 55000.00 | 60000.00 | 55000.00 | 15000.00 | approved |
| 40000.00 | 70000.00 | 60000.00 | 60000.00 | 20000.00 | approved at a reduced limit |
| 60000.00 | 90000.00 | 90000.00 | 90000.00 | 30000.00 | referred to committee; granted figure nothing |
| 120000.00 | 140000.00 | 180000.00 | 140000.00 | 20000.00 | approved |

A request dated the same latest day as another permanent request: nothing is decided and no limit is granted.
